run_goal: Populate the global corpus with traceable cases and open data sources that can train, calibrate, falsify or stress the Cousteau transformed-echo pipeline.

priority_scale.P0: directly downloadable raw/near-raw data with metadata/calibration useful now
priority_scale.P1: resolved physical false-positive or engineered control with strong measurable signature
priority_scale.P2: useful contextual/control case but incomplete for full transfer-function testing
priority_scale.P4: secondary historical account; archive-acquisition target only

raw_data_harvest_targets.data: free globally accessible raw audio and derived products
raw_data_harvest_targets.limitation: passive recordings do not by themselves test active-sonar transformed echo
mostly passive ambient sound, not known active illumination

raw_data_harvest_targets.calibration: device sensitivity metadata and post-deployment calibration fields documented
raw_data_harvest_targets.limitation: some raw offshore streams can be diverted/delayed for security reasons

raw_data_harvest_targets.access: map viewer plus public cloud/archive routes
raw_data_harvest_targets.special_value: closer to Cousteau active-return physics than passive-audio-only archives

uses: paired bathymetry plus water-column active-sonar control

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: strong coherent layer that can resemble a second moving seafloor; typically migrates vertically between day and night
adversarial_case_harvest.mechanism: collective scattering from organisms including fish swim bladders
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: seafloor-like reflector must not be promoted to fixed engineered geometry if it migrates with diel biology

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: near-vertical high-reflectivity water-column feature anchored to a seafloor source
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: vertical/fixed bright target must survive bubble-plume morphology and water-column behavior controls

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: vertical chimney-like diffractions, abrupt reflectivity changes and reflection wipeout
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: buried geometric-looking seismic anomaly is not automatically a structure

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: 40 Hz fundamental with 40 Hz overtone spacing; harmonic comb can include approximately 520 Hz
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: single 520-Hz or harmonic-comb detection fails specificity without geometry/phase/path evidence

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: steady 32-35 Hz tones, long frequency sweeps, grounding events and broadband icequakes detectable across thousands of km
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: machine-like motion/sweep and extraordinary detection range are not technology indicators

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: fundamental around 10 Hz with harmonics and drifting spectral peaks in multi-minute packets
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: harmonic structure plus spectral drift requires volcanic/geophysical control

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: undulating single-frequency low-frequency signal; PMEL example filtered 8-20 Hz
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: narrow-band whistle is not target resonance absent localization and echo geometry

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: specific tone ramping to about 270 Hz for about 3 minutes
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: clean engineered tonal energy can be emitted illumination/beacon, not target transfer

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: nearby vessel overwhelms other sounds and saturates hydrophone
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: reject harmonic distortion/ringing caused by clipping before physical target inference

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: stable 50 kHz line attributed to observatory power supply
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: fixed narrow line may belong to sensor/platform power system; require station self-noise inventory

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: low-frequency energy can refract within seafloor and return to water; surface/bottom ducts extend range and change apparent arrival geometry
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: delays, displaced foci and long range must survive ray/path alternatives before target motion or resonance is inferred

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: multiple active sonars can interfere; Okeanos operations use K-Sync to reduce interference
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: multi-instrument spectral lines or repeated returns require synchronization/crosstalk audit

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: direct overlap with Cousteau nominal flooded 512-529 Hz neighborhood
historically machine-like repetitive signal with harmonics
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: regularity and machine-like character are non-specific

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: calls documented in 200-400 Hz band in Antarctic hydrophone records
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: expands biological near-band control below nominal 520 neighborhood

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: seasonal train of narrow-band upsweeps detectable across Pacific
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: retain as morphology/history control but hard-reject from 520-Hz candidate set under current absolute-frequency evidence

adversarial_case_harvest.signature: unknown-source call documented in Gulf of Alaska hydrophone work with seasonal/geographic variation
adversarial_case_harvest.cousteau_test: unknown biological-source classes prevent unknown-signal-equals-engineered reasoning

immediate_data_actions: Harvest a fixed low-frequency 10-2000 Hz sample matrix from NOAA NRS across all 13 stations with held-out regions.
Harvest calibrated ONC fixed-hydrophone clips containing ships, cetaceans, earthquakes and quiet controls; preserve device sensitivity and deployment metadata.
Harvest NOAA water-column sonar examples with labeled gas seeps and matched no-seep frames.
Harvest raw Okeanos multibeam plus SVP plus water-column data from cruises where wrecks, seeps or volcanic targets have independent ground truth.
Build known-sensor self-noise registry before accepting any persistent spectral line.
Keep Africa frozen-point coverage search independent from global corpus training to avoid target leakage.
